name: What steps are involved in the roof leak restoration process with your company?

mainEntity.name: What steps are involved in the roof leak restoration process with your company?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our restoration process for storm-related roof leaks typically starts with an immediate inspection to identify the leak and assess all damage. We then implement emergency mitigation services, such as tarping or board-up, to prevent further water intrusion. Next, we provide a detailed plan for water extraction, drying, and repairing or replacing damaged roofing materials and interior structures. We also assist with documentation for your insurance claim, ensuring a smooth and comprehensive restoration from start to finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves immediate inspection, emergency mitigation, water extraction, drying, repair of damaged materials, and insurance claim assistance.
